text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry I couldn't make it to training!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...When I was cleaning the classroom with a friend,
the teacher asked us,
'Could you help out with the hallway too?'

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
People who saw it kept spreading it, one after another...
From the science lab to the student council room, and finally all the way to the Three Goddesses statue...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"The strong wind blew leaves and trash everywhere.
Everyone looked to be having such a hard time that I just had to help out...
I'm so, so sorry!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she got caught up in the mess.
Since she showed remorse, I simply told her to be more careful in the future.
